candidate.definition_en: A particular way of considering something; a point of view.
candidate.explanation_ar: وجهة نظر أو طريقة معينة بتشوف بيها الأمور.

senses.definition_en: A particular way of considering something; a point of view.
senses.explanation_ar: وجهة نظر أو منظور لرؤية وتقييم الأمور.
examples: Try to see things from my perspective.
Traveling gives you a new perspective on life.
The novel is written from the perspective of a child.
